modelIdentification.name: ENSIM-OrgDoctrineModel
modelIdentification.purpose: Federates org-doctrine-model records (Organization, Role, C2Node, DoctrineProcess, Mission) so ENSIM study/mission federates can share the org/doctrine layer described in docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md Section 6.
modelIdentification.description: Deliberately minimal: rather than modeling each org-doctrine-model entity type's fields as separate HLA attributes (which would duplicate packages/org-doctrine-model/schema as a second, hand-maintained type definition — the exact drift AGENTS.md Section 5 warns against), every record is carried as a single opaque JSON payload attribute. The JSON Schema in packages/org-doctrine-model/schema remains the one canonical definition of what an Organization/Role/C2Node/DoctrineProcess/Mission record contains; this FOM only needs to change if a new *entity type* is added, not when a record's fields change.
modelIdentification.useLimitation: ENSIM-internal only; not a published SISO FOM module.
modelIdentification.other: See packages/federation-kernel/README.md for how this FOM is used.

objectClass.name: OrgDoctrineModel
objectClass.semantics: Root for org-doctrine-model entities federated by federation-kernel.

objectClass.name: Record
objectClass.semantics: A single org-doctrine-model record, carried as its canonical JSON payload.

attribute.name: EntityId
attribute.semantics: The record's stable entityId (matches its id field in org-doctrine-model data), e.g. "pacaf" or "mission-001-hickam-luzon-airdrop".

attribute.name: EntityType
attribute.semantics: One of Organization, Role, C2Node, DoctrineProcess, Mission (org-doctrine-model's five entity types, ARCHITECTURE.md Section 6).

attribute.name: RecordJson
attribute.updateCondition: Record published or updated by its owning federate
attribute.semantics: The full record as JSON, matching its org-doctrine-model schema (organization.schema.json, role.schema.json, c2node.schema.json, doctrine-process.schema.json, or mission.schema.json).
